macos.rationale: The introduction offers a macOS app; Windows and Linux desktop apps were not established. Scope: Amp web, Mac and iOS, Amp CLI, Amp Orbs.

windows.rationale: Experimental native Windows app, Windows 10 1809+/11, x64/Arm.

linux.rationale: The first-party Linux app page gives native desktop installation, tray and systemd-runner instructions.

web-client.rationale: Web threads run in Orbs at ampcode.com. Scope: Amp web, Mac and iOS, Amp CLI, Amp Orbs.

ios.rationale: The introduction lists iPhone, iPad and Android apps; release restrictions need per-app verification. Scope: Amp web, Mac and iOS, Amp CLI, Amp Orbs.

android.rationale: The introduction lists iPhone, iPad and Android apps; release restrictions need per-app verification. Scope: Amp web, Mac and iOS, Amp CLI, Amp Orbs.

cli.rationale: The CLI runs locally or in scripts. Scope: Amp web, Mac and iOS, Amp CLI, Amp Orbs.

byo-subscription.rationale: The pricing guide supports linking ChatGPT and Claude subscriptions. Scope: Amp web, Mac and iOS, Amp CLI, Amp Orbs.

local.rationale: The CLI can run Amp on the user's own machine. Scope: Amp web, Mac and iOS, Amp CLI, Amp Orbs.

vendor-cloud.rationale: Orbs are per-thread machines that continue working when the laptop closes. Scope: Amp web, Mac and iOS, Amp CLI, Amp Orbs.

own-server.rationale: Own Orb provider supplies execution on user infrastructure.

parallel-runs.rationale: The Orb guide describes several independent tasks running at once, each with its own environment. Scope: Amp web, Mac and iOS, Amp Orbs.

coordinator.rationale: Task executes delegated work and Read Thread summarizes threads. Built-in Task subagents follow the thread's model and effort; custom plugin agents can define model choices. Further scoped facts are recorded in the atomic answers. Scope: Amp web, Mac and iOS, Amp CLI, Amp Orbs.

unattended-triggers.rationale: Amp saves one schedule per thread; it can run once or repeat, with pause, resume and delete controls. Scope: Amp web, Mac and iOS, Amp Orbs.

multiplayer.rationale: Workspace teammates can prompt together in an enabled multiplayer thread. Scope: Amp web, Mac and iOS, Amp CLI, Amp Orbs.

sso.rationale: Teams list SAML/OIDC SSO; Enterprise adds SCIM. Scope: Amp web, Mac and iOS, Amp CLI, Amp Orbs.

pr-workflow.rationale: Orbs can push branches and open PRs using a connected GitHub identity. Scope: Amp web, Mac and iOS, Amp Orbs.

review-ui.rationale: The thread's Changes view shows the diff, alongside files, services and conversation. Scope: Amp web, Mac and iOS, Amp Orbs.

laptop-independent.rationale: Orbs are per-thread machines that continue working when the laptop closes. Scope: Amp web, Mac and iOS, Amp CLI, Amp Orbs.

container.rationale: Self-hosted Docker-backed Orbs are explicitly documented.

worktree.rationale: Runner New Worktree creates separate working files and branch.

roles.rationale: Member and Admin have documented permission differences.

license.rationale: Main Amp service/application access uses custom Amp License Terms.

self-hosting.rationale: Security reference explicitly excludes self-hosted control-plane deployments; own Orbs do not meet the core-ADE threshold.

free-tier.rationale: Recurring Hobby tier is free; inference and compute remain separately payable.

starting-price.rationale: Hobby has a recurring $0 ADE fee; usage charges excluded.

free-plan.rationale: Hobby is recurring free beside paid Megawatt.

usage-based.rationale: Credits bought after included usage is consumed.

compute.rationale: Hosted Orb sizes billed hourly by the minute.

byok.rationale: Own subscriptions and API keys incur no Amp fees outside Enterprise.

no-paid-plan.rationale: The complete public tier table has recurring individual tiers, metered usage/Orbs and Teams with no extra charge. It omits a no-paid-plan ADE model; custom Enterprise terms are not inferred.

per-seat.rationale: The complete public tier table has recurring individual tiers, metered usage/Orbs and Teams with no extra charge. It omits a per-seat ADE model; custom Enterprise terms are not inferred.

one-time.rationale: The complete public tier table has recurring individual tiers, metered usage/Orbs and Teams with no extra charge. It omits a one-time ADE model; custom Enterprise terms are not inferred.

paid-from.rationale: Megawatt $20/month is the lowest listed paid tier. Rechecked against the eligible finding on 2026-11-13: this paid offering remains distinct from no paid plan. Original source-check date retained; independent mapping review cleared for the revised definition.
